full_prompt_en: A square fashion photograph shows two young models pressed close together against a nearly black background, rendered in a glossy but grain-flecked monochrome editorial style. The left side is filled by a short-haired figure in a dark jacket, their face angled down toward the lower left and their eyes held in deep shadow. Bright light catches the straight fringe, forehead, bridge of the nose, and pale cheek, while the lower half of the clothing merges into the surrounding dark field. Near the center, the second figure leans beside them with a darker upturned hairstyle, a delicate mesh veil crossing the forehead and eyes, and a long clustered earring hanging toward the shoulder. Their face turns partly toward the camera, with softly parted lips and a clear highlight running along the cheek and nose. Fine speckling in the veil contrasts with the smooth tonal modeling of both faces. Thin pale threads and small glints from the adornments break up the broad black areas without turning the image into a decorative pattern. The two heads overlap closely, leaving little open space, and the eye moves between the illuminated faces and the dense shadow around them. Strong directional studio light from the upper left creates silver highlights and abrupt dark passages, while the background remains almost completely unlit. The overall composition is intimate and compressed, with sharp facial highlights, velvety blacks, and tactile editorial grain creating a tense, elegant mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形时尚摄影中，两位年轻模特紧靠在近乎黑色的背景前，画面采用带细微颗粒的光泽感黑白编辑摄影风格。左侧被一位短发人物占据，脸朝左下方倾斜，眼睛陷在深阴影里。明亮光线照到平直刘海、额头、鼻梁和浅亮的脸颊，衣服下半部则融入周围暗部。靠近中央，第二位人物贴在其身旁，头发深色并向上梳起，细网面纱掠过额头和眼睛，一只成簇的长耳饰垂向肩部。其脸部分朝向镜头，双唇微张，脸颊与鼻梁上有清楚的亮光。面纱上的细点与两张脸平滑的明暗塑形形成对照。装饰上的细浅线条和小亮点打破大片黑色，却没有把画面变成装饰图案。两颗头颅紧密交叠，留白很少，视线在受光面孔和周围浓重阴影之间移动。来自左上方的强烈定向影棚光形成银亮高光和骤然转暗的区域，背景几乎完全不受照亮。整体构图亲密而紧凑，以锐利的面部亮部、柔绒般的黑色和可触的编辑摄影颗粒营造紧张而优雅的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a high-contrast monochrome photographic finish built from compressed near-black masses and small, carefully placed silver highlights. Smooth tonal transitions across the focal surfaces meet abrupt pockets of shadow, so volume emerges selectively rather than through even illumination. Fine film-like grain and a faint mesh of tiny marks add tactile detail to otherwise polished areas. Most edges disappear into darkness while a few bright contours stay crisp, concentrating attention within a crowded, close-set arrangement. Directional studio light is narrow and dramatic, and the dark ground offers almost no depth cues beyond overlapping tones. The overall visual effect is intimate, severe, and elegant.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现高反差黑白摄影质感，由紧密压缩的近黑色块和少量精心落下的银亮高光构成。焦点表面上的平滑明暗过渡与突然出现的阴影区域相接，使体积只在局部显现，而非受到均匀照明。细密的胶片式颗粒和微小网点为原本光滑的区域增加触感。大多数边缘消失在黑暗里，少数受光轮廓保持清晰，把注意力集中在拥挤而紧贴的布局中。定向影棚光狭窄且富于戏剧性，深暗底色除了色调重叠几乎不给出纵深线索。整体视觉效果亲密、冷峻而优雅。
theme_en: A dramatic black-and-white fashion close-up of two models
theme_zh: 两位模特的戏剧性黑白时尚近景
name: Mert and Marcus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
